details: Definition: the maximization defining $\mathrm{XTD}$ includes targets in the class, for which specifying sets are teaching sets.
name: Extended Teaching Dimension / Teaching Dimension
proof: For every target $h\in\mathcal H$, a specifying set for $h$ among all labelings is in particular a teaching set for $h$ within $\mathcal H$. Since $\mathrm{XTD}$ maximizes over a superset of targets, it is at least $\mathrm{TD}$.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
